categories.name: Printr Launchpad

categories.name: Virtual Reality

categories.name: AUD Stablecoin
categories.content: A AUD stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency that is designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to the Australian Dollar (AUD).

categories.name: topblast.lol Ecosystem
categories.content: topblast.lol is a launchpad on The Open Network (TON), integrating fair-launch mechanics with a comprehensive Telegram-native DeFi ecosystem.

categories.name: Four.Meme Tokenized Stocks (4Stock)
categories.content: Tokens issued by Four.Meme under its 4Stock product. Each 4Stock is intended to be backed by its corresponding underlying share, purchased and held by Four.Meme through a dedicated managed account.

categories.name: SPL22
categories.content: SPL22 is a hybrid token extension of the Solana blockchain that combines the features of both fungible and non-fungible tokens.

categories.name: BagsApp Ecosystem

categories.name: Arcade Games

categories.name: Pools Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Pools (https://pools.trade/), Uniswap's first-party token issuance platform.

categories.name: Uniswap v4 Hooks
categories.content: Tokens of protocols whose core product is built on Uniswap v4 hooks. Hooks turn the AMM from fixed infrastructure into a programmable platform, enabling designs that were impossible in earlier versions: dynamic fees that widen during volatility, MEV-mitigation through batched uniform-clearing-price execution, rehypothecation of idle liquidity into lending markets, vault-managed concentrated liquidity issued as fungible ERC-6909 positions, limit orders implemented as single-tick positions, and lending markets that share collateral with swap liquidity. Projects in this category use hooks as the foundation of their product rather than merely trading on Uniswap.

categories.name: Guild and Scholarship
categories.content: Guilds are decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs) that invests in NFTs like game assets and rent them out to players. Players who receive rented game items are known as scholars and can be said to receive a scholarship. Guilds are an important component in the play to earn (P2E) ecosystem as these games require an upfront investment capital for players to participate in.

categories.name: Augmented Reality
categories.content: Augmented Reality (AR) offers interactive experiences without disconnecting users from the real world, allowing them to interact with digital elements in a real-world context.

categories.name: Hybrid Token Standards
categories.content: Hybrid Token Standards allow tokens to have characteristics of both fungible assets and non-fungible tokens.
